info.title: Doma Protocol API
info.description: Doma Protocol API (Poll API + Orderbook API) for D3's on-chain domain tokenization protocol. Aggregated by API Evangelist from the per-operation OpenAPI fragments published in the Doma docs (docs.doma.xyz). Authenticate with an Api-Key header; rate limited to 10 req/s.

get.description: Returns blockchain events that have occurred since the last acknowledged event.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor identifier to use for tracking the polling state. Can be used to manage multiple independent polling states.

parameters.name: eventTypes
parameters.description: Filter events by type. Can be provided multiple times to filter by multiple types.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return in a single response page.

parameters.name: includeSynthetics
parameters.description: Whether to include synthetic token events.

parameters.name: finalizedOnly
parameters.description: Whether to return only finalized events.

proofSource.description:
Indicates the source of contacts information. "registrantHandle" is used as a unique identifier within this source. Following values are possible: 
0 - NONE. No contacts provided. Only used for EOIs. 
1 - REGISTRAR. Registrar has approved claim, and holds the contact information. "registrantHandle" holds internal registrar-supplied identifier. 
2 - DOMA. Doma has approved claim, and holds the contact information. "registrantHandle" holds contacts identifier in Doma API, that should be used with /registrant/{handle} API to obtain encrypted contact information.

registrantHandle.description: Unique identifier that can be used to obtain contact information.
